purpose: Freeze a Qwen3-4B mixed-corpus retest using Hugging Face datasets as source pools while preserving provenance and preventing source-tier label leakage into Stage B.

model.name: Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Base
model.claim_boundary: parameter-efficient continued-pretraining evidence for a mixed Python candidate corpus

stress_mix.role: raw-heavy stress test after primary mix

raw_like.role: primary raw-like permissive code source when local access and metadata filters are feasible
raw_like.sampling_policy: python-only permissive-license sample with repository concentration caps

raw_like.role: fallback raw-like GitHub code source for smaller controlled pilot
raw_like.sampling_policy: python-only sample with Stage-0 license and generated-file filters

known_high_quality_reference.role: reference pool for documented code/search examples
known_high_quality_reference.sampling_policy: python subset where available; reference label retained only for audit
function-level examples; reference label retained only for audit

stage_b_allowed_inputs: coverage support metadata after source-tier blinding

success_rule.primary: curated_equal_token must beat raw_mixed_random_equal_token and stageA_random_equal_token on heldout code NLL or the frozen EvalPlus macro aggregate without guardrail regression.
success_rule.reference_interpretation: known_high_quality_reference_equal_token is context, not an oracle and not a selector label.
success_rule.failure_action: report fail or abstain; do not change Stage B after Stage-C outcomes.

utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
